column1: # al-Muṭlaq wa-l-muqayyad: 15 canonical pairs for H-CLASSIC-28
# Source doctrine: al-Suyūṭī, al-Itqān fī ʿulūm al-Qurʾān, nawʿ on muṭlaq/muqayyad
#   (PENDING physical verification — likely nawʿ 45 or adjacent, verbatim confidence on nawʿ-number: PENDING)
# Secondary: al-Zarkashī, al-Burhān fī ʿulūm al-Qurʾān, fī al-muṭlaq wa-l-muqayyad
# Uṣūl al-fiqh cross-reference: al-Shāfiʿī, al-Risāla; al-Ghazālī, al-Mustaṣfā on
#   "yuḥmalu al-muṭlaq ʿalā al-muqayyad idhā ittaḥada l-sabab wa-l-ḥukm"
# Purpose: ground-truth pair list for H-CLASSIC-28. For each pair:
#   - muṭlaq_verse: Quranic verse where the token is unrestricted (absolute)
#   - muqayyad_verse: Quranic verse where the same token is restricted by qayd (qualifier)
#   - shared_token: the lexeme or root that is restricted in one and unrestricted in the other
#   - qayd_type: the kind of restriction (sifa/adjective, number, ḥāl/circumstance, etc.)
#   - classical_verdict: whether the two must be read together per classical uṣūl (WAJIB/MUSTAHABB/DISPUTED)
#   HIGH = canonical pair in both Suyūṭī Itqān and al-Shāfiʿī Risāla, undisputed
#   MEDIUM = in Itqān or Burhān but pair-status discussed (some scholars dispute whether sabab/ḥukm unify)
#   LOW = single-source attestation or dispute among major schools
